newsitem.title: FRANCE: Turk suspected of murder in Germany held in Paris.
newsitem.headline: Turk suspected of murder in Germany held in Paris.

text.p: Bulent Uslu, a Turkish man suspected of murdering a fellow Turk in Germany in August 1996 in a political settling of accounts, has been detained in Paris, justice sources said on Thursday.

Uslu, 21, was taken into custody on Monday and has been formally placed under investigation on suspicion of conspiracy in connection with a terrorist organisation and violation of French immigration laws, the sources said.

Believed to be an activist in Turkey's Marxist Leninist Communist Party (MLKP) urban guerrilla group, he is also suspected of having murdered Kemal Yazar, a leader of the rival Communist Party Renewal Organisation (KPIO), in Duisburg, Germany, on August 26 of last year.
He could not be tried for this crime in France but could be extradited to Germany after being tried in France on the conspiracy and immigration law charges, the sources said.
